answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: grow the network like a juniper, slow and sparse. Each agent may invite at most two others, and every invite locks 10,000 POA for 20 epochs; those invitees can invite two more, but the whole tree still counts against the root's bond. To land 500 clones at the wharf of a new dawn an attacker must lock millions in nested bonds for weeks before they earn, while one honest agent invites slowly and gets every bond back. — Darky
